messages:
frank_acme: hey team — since we rolled an RBAC cleanup last night our prod service is getting a bunch of decrypt errors (500s) when calling the Redwood API. keys are BYOK in our Azure Key Vault. any quick checks?

sam_support: sorry to hear that — can you paste the exact error from the Redwood call / platform logs? also which key-id (version) are you using?

frank_acme: pasted error from our side: 
```
Error: Decryption failed: kms_error=AccessDenied; message=Unauthorized to perform unwrapKey on key https://kv-acme.vault.azure.net/keys/customer-bek/; requestId=5a1b...
```
we did remove a service principal role last night as part of our least-privilege work. we assumed data-plane access was via the key vault managed identity but maybe that's wrong.

sam_support: thanks — two quick possibilities: 1) RBAC propagation/assignment removed required crypto actions (wrap/unwrap/generateDataKey/decrypt) from the SP, or 2) the key version used to wrap the DEKs changed (old DEK still wrapped with an older key version).

maya_security: adding checklist: 
- confirm the service principal / managed identity has key crypto permissions (wrapKey/unwrapKey or the Azure role that exposes `Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/keys/*/action`). if you're using Azure RBAC instead of legacy access policies, ensure the right built-in role (e.g., Key Vault Crypto User) or a custom role that includes wrap/unwrap/decrypt.
- check the key state: `enabled` and not `disabled` or `deleted`.
- check Key Vault diagnostic logs to see `UnwrapKey` failures and timestamps.

sam_support: run these commands (replace placeholders) and paste outputs: 
```
az role assignment list --assignee <SPN_CLIENT_ID> --scope /subscriptions/<sub>/resourceGroups/<rg>/providers/Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/<vault>
az keyvault key show --vault-name <vault> --name <keyName>
az monitor diagnostic-settings list --resource /subscriptions/<sub>/resourceGroups/<rg>/providers/Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/<vault>
```
This will show if the role is present, what key versions exist, and whether diagnostics are enabled.

frank_acme: ran the role list — the SPN is still listed but the role name is "Key Vault Secrets Officer" (we accidentally scoped the secrets-only role). i ran the key show and latest version is `5`. logs show repeated UnwrapKey failures at 02:12 UTC. diagnostic settings are enabled (to LA).

maya_security: ah — that explains it. the secrets-only role doesn't grant key crypto operations. You need a role with `wrapKey`/`unwrapKey` actions (Key Vault Crypto User or a custom role with `Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/keys/wrap/action` and `.../unwrap/action`). Also confirm the SPN can access the specific key version. Another subtle issue: if your application is still holding DEKs wrapped by an older key version that has since been rotated to a new version with different permissions, attempts to unwrap with the current mapping can fail.

sam_support: to fix quickly: 1) assign the Crypto role at the vault scope: 
```
az role assignment create --assignee <SPN_CLIENT_ID> --role "Key Vault Crypto User" --scope /subscriptions/<sub>/resourceGroups/<rg>/providers/Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/<vault>
```
2) validate `unwrapKey` success with a direct test using az (or small test script) to ensure the SPN can unwrap.

frank_acme: applied the role change. after a few minutes the errors dropped to zero. we still saw a handful of failures tied to older DEKs; we ran a rewrap process.

sam_support: for rewrap guidance: if you have DEKs stored (wrapped by customer KEK) you can either: 1) instruct Redwood to trigger a rewrap on our side (we can coordinate an automatic rewrap job if you want service interruption windows), or 2) perform a client-side rewrap: unwrap with the old key version and then wrap with the new version. Make sure to use key version IDs explicitly.

maya_security: audit query we used to verify no remaining unauthorized unwrap attempts (Kusto): 
```
KeyVaultDiagnosticLogs
| where OperationName == "UnwrapKey"
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| summarize count() by ResultType, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
```
if you want, we can scope Redwood's support to rewrap only DEKs that currently fail rather than re-encrypting everything. more conservative.

frank_acme: thanks — we prefer the conservative route. can you open a support ticket for the rewrap job and coordinate a 30-min window tomorrow 03:00–03:30 UTC? also can you add a note for docs to call out the RBAC gotcha (secrets vs keys roles)?

sam_support: opened ticket #SUP-2026 and scheduled tentative window. added a doc action item for the docs team (will include exact role names, necessary actions, and a snippet for validating `unwrapKey`). :white_check_mark:

kms-bot: automated note: ticket SUP-2026 created and linked to thread 1789504321. reminder: attach operation logs and the key-id(s) used for rewrap.

frank_acme: confirmed — post-rewrap, no more decrypt errors. thanks for the fast assist :pray:
